title: feat(plugin-report): the report page reads dateRange — a period chip and one timeDimensions window
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8JxkmA6W2aMBEb6B3khkD7o)_
Refs #25873 (item: the report page reads dateRange)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：报表声明了 `dateRange` 后，报表页顶部出现时间范围选择（全部时间、仪表盘同款预设、可选自定义起止日期），表格、交叉表和内嵌图表都只统计所选时间段。
- 为什么改：裁决 B（时间范围 + 导出）的第一半；规格 #26548 已发布 `dateRange`，但此前没有任何渲染器读取它，报表总是显示全部时间。
- 风险与回滚：未声明 `dateRange` 的报表发出的查询与之前逐字节相同；风险限于声明了它的报表。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-report/src/ReportDateRange.tsx`（选择器与维度解析）、`DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` 中 `useDatasetRows` 的 `timeDimensions` 一行、`packages/spec/liveness/report.json` 的 `dateRange` 子树。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/DatasetReportRenderer.dateRange-25873.test.tsx`，预期 8 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The chip.** A non-joined report that declares `dateRange` draws a date-range chip above its body (`ReportDateRangeControl`): All time, the dashboard's `DATE_RANGE_PRESETS` under the dashboard's `dashboard.filters.range.*` labels, and Custom… (two date inputs) unless `allowCustomRange: false`. It opens on `defaultRange`, or the spec default `this_month`; `custom` opens the custom pick with no window until both ends are named.
- **The window.** The active window rides every dataset query the report makes (grouped table, matrix cross-tab, embedded chart) through the one fetch choke point `useDatasetRows`, as one `selection.timeDimensions` entry `{ dimension, dateRange }` with no `granularity`: a preset by name, a custom pick as `[start, end]`, All time as no entry. The window is part of the refetch signature, so a new pick re-queries.
- **The dimension.** A declared `dimension` goes on the wire as written. Omitted, the renderer reads the dataset definition (`/api/v1/meta/dataset/NAME` through the host's `apiFetch`, the read `ObjectChart`'s dataset path makes) before any query and uses its one `type: 'date'` dimension. None or several draws that authoring error in place of the body and queries nothing, so no unwindowed table renders under a period chip.
- **Unchanged without it.** No `dateRange` means no chip, no dataset-definition read, and the selection posted before. `joined` reports (where the spec refuses `dateRange`) are not read.
- **Liveness.** `packages/spec/liveness/report.json`: `dateRange` and its three children flip `planned` → `live` citing the read points; `authorWarn` / `authorHint` dropped; `state-counts/report.md` regenerated. `exportOptions` stays `planned` (slice 2).
- **i18n.** `report.dateRange.{from,to,datasetUnreadable,noSingleDateDimension}` in all ten locale packs (the German pack names the dataset without a „“ pair, which `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` counts).
- Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-report` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch. No `@object-ui/core` edit was needed: `DATE_RANGE_PRESETS` is already exported.

## Tests

- New `DatasetReportRenderer.dateRange-25873.test.tsx`, 8 cases: the `defaultRange` window on every query (table and chart) with the chip text; chip change re-queries (`this_quarter`, then All time = no entry); custom `[start, end]` only once both ends are set; `allowCustomRange: false` offers no Custom…; absent `defaultRange` = `this_month`; omitted dimension resolved from the dataset definition before the first query; two date dimensions = error, zero queries; CONTROL: no `dateRange` = no chip, no definition read, no `timeDimensions` key.
- Ablation (commit `cff7be71`): deleting the `timeDimensions` spread in `useDatasetRows` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0) turns the 5 cases that assert a posted window red; the 3 that assert none is needed (the control, the two-date-dimension error, the no-Custom case) stay green, as expected. Restored blob = HEAD blob `fe27e545`.

## Acceptance notes

- Drill-down from a windowed report: the drill event carries `runtimeFilter` and the bucket, not the period, so the record list it opens is not limited to the window (a superset, the same direction the server's drill metadata already takes for unknown date field types). Carrying the window into the drill needs the host (`ReportView`, app-shell), outside this slice's file surface; listed in the report for the seat.
- The picked period is component state, not URL state; a refresh reopens on `defaultRange`.
